candidate.answerReason: Losses account for 4 of the 11 + 4 = 15 ratio parts. Their percentage is 26.666...%, which rounds to 27%.

methods.label: Compare losses with all games
methods.explanation:
The ratio gives \(11\) parts wins for every \(4\) parts losses. Since there are no ties, all games together make \(11+4=15\) equal ratio parts, of which \(4\) are losses.

Thus the percentage of games lost is
\[
\frac4{15}\cdot100\%=26.666\ldots\%.
\]
Rounding to the nearest whole percent gives \(27\%\), choice \(\text{B}\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses elementary ratio parts, conversion to a percentage, and rounding.
